book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazʉmu ga Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ chɨmbu gaandikirwɨ na Mataayo

content: Yɨɨsu araryʉka
Hanʉ urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtʉʉrʉ rwahitirɨ, mʉmacha urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ rwi inyuma,
Mariyamu wa Magidarena hamwɨmwɨ na Mariyamu ʉwʉndɨ wurya, bhakaja korora imbihɨra.
Rogendo rʉmwɨ, kɨkabhaho ikirigitʉ kɨkʉrʉ chɨ ɨɨsɨ, kʉ kʉbha maraika wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu akiika kurwa mwisaarʉ. Maraika wuyo akiisuka kumbihɨra, akahiringitya riibhwɨ rirya rusizʉ, akaryikarɨra.
Aarɨ arabharya nchʉ ʉrʉkʉbha, na zengebho zaazɨ zaarɨ nzɨrʉ pee ncho omosoke.
Hanʉ abhasirikarɨ bharya bhaarʉʉzɨ gayo, bhakʉʉbhaha bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakabha nkina bhakuurɨ.
Hayo, maraika wuyo akabhʉʉrɨra abhakari bharya, “Mʉtʉʉbhaha! Nɨɨzɨ mʉramohya Yɨɨsu wa Nazarɨɨti, wʉnʉ aabhambirwɨ.
Atarɨ hanʉ! Aryukirɨ, chɨmbu aabhugirɨ. Muuzɨ morore hanʉ bhaarɨ bhamʉtɨɨrɨ.
Mujɨ bhwangʉ, mʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ abhɨɨga bhaazɨ, ‘Aryukirɨ kurwa kʉbhaku, na arabhakangatɨra kuja mucharʉ cha Gariraaya. Iyo nɨyu mokomobhona!’ Nangʉ nɨmarirɨ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra kɨnʉ charɨ kɨndɨɨtirɨ!”
Neho abhakari bhayo bhakabhʉʉka bhwangʉ kurwa mumbihɨra hayo, bhanu ubhwʉbha no obhozomerwa bhʉkʉrʉ. Bhakaryara kuja kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra abhɨɨga ganʉ maraika aabhabhuuriirɨ.
Mmbe, hanʉ bhaarɨ bharaja, Yɨɨsu akarumana nabhʉ, akabhakeerya, “Morembe!” Bhakamwisukɨra, bhakamugwata amagʉrʉ gaazɨ, bhakamosengera.
Neho Yɨɨsu akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Mʉtʉʉbhaha. Mujɨ mʉbhabhʉʉrɨrɨ abhahiiri bhaanɨ
bhajɨ Gariraaya, iyo nɨyu bharaambone.”
Abhariibhi bhi imbihɨra ya Yɨɨsu bharagamba ʉrʉrɨmɨ

Hanʉ abhakari bhayo bhaarɨ bhakuja, abhasirikarɨ obhorebhe abhariibhi bhi imbihɨra ya Yɨɨsu bhakaja mʉrʉbhɨri rwa Yɨrusarɨɨmu. Hanʉ bhaahikirɨ, bhakaragɨrɨra abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani gʉʉsi ganʉ gaakʉriibhwɨ.
Akʉmara abhakʉrʉ bha abhakuhaani bhayo bhakarumana na abhakaruka bha Abhayaahudi, bhakagambana na kuhitya kʉbhaha abhasirikarɨ bharyɨ amasooya ga zimpirya nzaru.
Bhakabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi araabhabhuuryɨ igʉrʉ wa ganʉ gakʉrirwɨ, mubhugɨ, ‘Ubhutikʉ twarɨ tuhindiirɨ zendooro, abhɨɨga bhakaaza bhakamwibha.’
Hanʉ Piraato ariigwɨ gayo, itwɨ tʉragambana nawe korereke mʉtaaza kusikɨra mʉnyaakʉ.”
Mmbe abhasirikarɨ bhakagega zimpirya na bhakakora chɨmbu bhaabhuuriirwɨ na abhakʉrʉ bha Abhayaahudi. Amangʼana gaabhʉ gʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ gakanyaragana bhʉkʉngʼu gatɨ wa Abhayaahudi kuhika reero yɨnʉ.
Amaswaja gɨ ɨtɨnɨrʉ ya Yɨɨsu kʉbhɨɨga bhaazɨ
Abhɨɨga bha Yɨɨsu ikumi na wʉmwɨ bhakaja Gariraaya mʉkɨgʉrʉ kɨnʉ Yɨɨsu aabhɨɨrɨkiryɨ.
Hanʉ bhaamʉrʉʉzɨ, bhakamosengera, nangabha abhandɨ bhaarɨ na amakɨbhwɨ kʉbha nɨ‑Yɨɨsu.
Yɨɨsu akabhiisukɨra, akabhabhʉʉrɨra, “Nɨhɨɨrwɨ ʉbhʉnaja bhwʉsi bhwa mwisaarʉ na mʉʉsɨ.
Nangʉ mujɨ kʉbhaatʉ bhi ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi na kʉbhakora kʉbha abhɨɨga bhaanɨ. Mʉbhabhatiizɨ kuriina rya Bhaabha, na ryu Umwana na rye Ekoro Ɨndɨndu.
Mubhiijɨ kugwata gʉʉsi ganʉ nabhaswajiryɨ imwɨ. Rora, na niinyɨ nɨrɨ hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ ribhaga ryʉsi, kuhika mʉtɨnɨrʉ yɨ ɨɨsɨ.”

footnotes.text: Urusikʉ rwʉ ʉbhʉtangɨ rwi inyuma kʉBhayaahudi ni‑Jumapiri.
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, enzobhooro yaku nɨ‑bhɨɨga bhaazɨ.
